[Gentlemen](/organisation/248)
I am much obliged for [£10](/topic/160) for the [publication](/topic/172) of the [Modern Telemachus](/book/185) I am sending the receipt to [Mr Asgood](/person/2367)
I remain &c

C M Yonge		
Messrs Harper


[^1]: The collection also includes a stamped receipt.
